openings.claim: Opposed removable strip-jaw clamps could carry sideways load through distributed pad friction, avoiding concentrated left-corner preload. Substitute matched small increments at opposed mid-edge contacts; pair four strips into upper/lower jaws, drill only strips, bolt outside fixture edges, pad contacts, cord-tie assemblies and park clear.
openings.discriminator: Rival: concentrated corner pressure supplies sufficient friction despite rocking. If distribution matters, matched clamps arrest sideways motion before opposite-corner lift reaches 2 mm; equivalent tightening concentrated left causes earlier lift. Tightening approximates preload comparison, not equal force.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, verify accessible rim undersides, bolt reach, strip overlap and pad placement without modifying hatch, rim or seal; otherwise park. Spend one available trial comparing reversible left-biased versus matched tightening, stopping at visible lift or seal distress. Use eleven remaining closure/pull trials: initial closure plus ten opening cycles, final closure with supplied 1 mm right-contact card. Record marked displacement under 20 N, corner lift, reopening time and visible seal condition; parts remain recoverable and entirely clear when open. Defeat: displacement beyond 1 mm, reopening beyond 30 seconds, seal tearing, obstruction, or exceeding ninety fabrication/twenty observation minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Rim access, bolt lengths and strip stiffness enabling stable jaws are indispensable unprovided geometry/capacity facts. Comparison fitting one trial and leaving eleven is an assumption. Right-contact disturbance could defeat pressure distribution. No supplied observation establishes clamp feasibility or compliance; success supports only this fixture configuration.

lineage.reason: Relation, rival/comparison, stops, uncertainty and declared uncertain fit preserved.

decision: Check geometry before fabrication; this remains a probe. Retain existing hatch/rim/seal; no hatch/trough drilling, cutting, glue or permanent deformation, powered joint mechanism, opening obstruction or new visible seal tears. Maximum two configurations/twelve trials; disturbed closure waives only seal continuity.
